title: Read a legacy .xls workbook
summary: Open an in-memory .xls (BIFF8) workbook of 3 or 4 sheets and read every cell value: strings, numbers, booleans and dates.
notes: Each adapter opens the .xls bytes (BIFF8 records inside an OLE compound file) with the library and returns the sheets and cell values mapped to a common list of { name, rows }. The verifier compares every cell against the values the scenario wrote.
